findings.evidence: Description has no boundary against near-miss neighbours (the ai-kit-spec-review-checklist reviewer skill, the ai-kit-spec-review-fixer, plain code or PR review, or writing a new spec)
findings.fix: Use when a design, spec, requirements, or plan document needs a review-and-fix loop before the next step. Framework-aware across superpowers, GSD, OpenSpec, Spec Kit, Kiro, BMAD and generic docs: orchestrates a clean-context reviewer and routes fixes to the right handler (native framework skill, slash command, or direct-edit fixer), with optional cross-AI reviewers via --cross-ai/--no-cross-ai. Respects worktrees, scopes to lifecycle stage, and loops until approved or the iteration cap. Use for 'review my spec/plan/design', /ai-kit-spec-review, PRD or RFC review, or doc paths passed for review, even if the framework is not named. Not for code or PR review, for writing a new spec or plan, or for running only the checklist reviewer (ai-kit-spec-review-checklist).
